title: トレーニングIMU
description: Basic Ingest → Firehose → S3 → Athena の動作確認用。schema_version 1/2 の両方を g 単位で表示する。

targets.rawSQL:
WITH batches AS (
  SELECT
    schema_version,
    samples,
    -- v2はミリ秒精度のbatch_start_msを使う。v1は秒精度のcaptured_atしか無い。
    CASE
      WHEN schema_version >= 2 AND batch_start_ms IS NOT NULL
        THEN from_unixtime(batch_start_ms / 1e3)
      ELSE CAST(from_iso8601_timestamp(captured_at) AS timestamp)
    END AS batch_time,
    set_id
  FROM telemetry_raw
  WHERE datehour = '${datehour}'
    AND device_id = '${device_id}'
),
windowed AS (
  -- サンプル展開の前に時間範囲で絞る。100 Hzでは1時間あたり36万行になるため。
  SELECT *
  FROM batches
  WHERE $__timeFilter(batch_time)
    AND ('${set_id}' = '' OR CAST(set_id AS varchar) = '${set_id}')
)
SELECT
  date_add('millisecond', s.offset_ms, batch_time) AS time,
  -- v2はmgの整数、v1はgの小数。表示はgに揃える。
  CASE WHEN schema_version >= 2 THEN s.ax / 1e3 ELSE s.ax END AS ax,
  CASE WHEN schema_version >= 2 THEN s.ay / 1e3 ELSE s.ay END AS ay,
  CASE WHEN schema_version >= 2 THEN s.az / 1e3 ELSE s.az END AS az
FROM windowed
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(samples) AS t(s)
ORDER BY time
